title: Northgate Card Credit Line, Security Deposit and Account Eligibility Terms by Card
content:
Harbor Point Bank, N.A. assigns credit lines on **Northgate Card Credit Accounts (issued by Harbor Point Bank, N.A.)** within the range each card carries. The table below gives each card's credit line range, its security deposit terms and the account figures tied to them.

## Credit line and deposit

| Card | Lowest credit limit assigned at opening | Highest credit limit the tier carries | Minimum refundable security deposit (0.00 on unsecured tiers) | Credit limit equals the security deposit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Secured Card | 200.00 USD | 2500.00 USD | 200.00 USD | yes |
| Northgate Store Card | 300.00 USD | 10000.00 USD | 0.00 USD | no |
| Northgate Mastercard | 500.00 USD | 15000.00 USD | 0.00 USD | no |
| Northgate World Mastercard | 5000.00 USD | 30000.00 USD | 0.00 USD | no |
| Northgate Business Store Card | 1000.00 USD | 25000.00 USD | 0.00 USD | no |
| Northgate Business Mastercard | 2500.00 USD | 50000.00 USD | 0.00 USD | no |

## Reviews, deposit refund and account figures

| Card | Consecutive on-time statement cycles after which a secured account is reviewed for an unsecured Northgate Store Card (0 means not applicable) | Minimum months on book, and months between reviews, before a requested credit line increase is considered | Business days after graduation or after closure with a zero balance within which the security deposit is refunded | Maximum authorized users or employee cards | Calendar days after a declined application before the customer may apply again |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Secured Card | 7 | 0 | 10 | 0 | 30 |
| Northgate Store Card | 0 (not applicable) | 6 | 10 | 4 | 30 |
| Northgate Mastercard | 0 (not applicable) | 6 | 10 | 4 | 30 |
| Northgate World Mastercard | 0 (not applicable) | 6 | 10 | 4 | 30 |
| Northgate Business Store Card | 0 (not applicable) | 6 | 10 | 25 | 30 |
| Northgate Business Mastercard | 0 (not applicable) | 6 | 10 | 25 | 30 |

**Notes.** The Northgate Secured Card is the only card with a security deposit; its deposit is at least 200.00 USD and its credit limit equals the deposit, within the 200.00 to 2500.00 USD range. The highest credit limit in the first table is the ceiling no credit limit on that card goes above.
